get_HEG_config: get the FermiNet configuration for an unpolarised 14 electron homogeneous electron gas
build_sc_lattice_vectors: build simple cubic lattice vectors from a Wigner-Seitz radius and electron count
run_HEG_simulation: run a FermiNet simulation of a 14 electron homogeneous electron gas using the default config
review_get_config: review the get_config function to understand how PBC feature layers and envelopes are configured
refactor_lattice_calculation: refactor the _sc_lattice_vecs function to support different lattice geometries beyond simple cubic
